dasha_guide.description: Practical guidance for each of 9 Mahadasha (major planetary period) in the Vimshottari system. Covers themes, focus areas, career, health, relationships, spiritual guidance, and practical advice.

sun.theme: Authority, self-expression, leadership, father, government, vitality
sun.career: Peak period for government jobs, politics, administration, leadership roles. Authority and recognition come naturally. Good time to seek promotions and take on leadership responsibilities.
sun.health: Focus on heart health, bone strength, and eye care. Sun-related ailments may surface. Pitta (fire) constitution heightened. Regular exercise and sun exposure beneficial.
sun.relationships: Father figure becomes important. Marriage needs ego balance. Relationships marked by need for respect and admiration. Partner should be supportive of career ambitions.
sun.spiritual: Self-realization journey begins. Atma-jnana (soul knowledge) develops. Good period for Gayatri mantra and Surya Namaskar. Connection with one's true purpose strengthens.
practical_advice: Build connections with authority figures and government
Focus on personal health, especially heart and eyes
Maintain humility despite rising status
Offer water to Sun at sunrise (Surya Arghya)
Wear Ruby or red garnet if Sun is well-placed
Avoid ego conflicts with authority figures
Strengthen relationship with father or father figures
sun.challenges: Ego inflation, authority conflicts, eye or heart problems, strained father relationship
sun.opportunities: Government favor, leadership positions, public recognition, health improvement

moon.theme: Emotions, mind, mother, public, travel, nurturing, intuition
moon.career: Good for public-facing careers, hospitality, nursing, counseling, travel industry. Public popularity increases. Career benefits from emotional intelligence and people skills.
moon.health: Watch for fluid retention, blood pressure fluctuations, mental health, and hormonal balance. Moon governs the mind, so meditation is essential. Cold and wet conditions may aggravate health.
moon.relationships: Mother's influence is paramount. Emotional bonds deepen. Marriage is nurturing but may involve mood swings. Partner's emotional needs must be attended to.
moon.spiritual: Excellent for meditation, bhakti (devotion), and mantra japa. Moon's period favors worship of Divine Mother (Devi). Dreams become prophetic. Intuition heightens.
practical_advice: Prioritize mental health and emotional stability
Strengthen relationship with mother
Practice meditation regularly, especially on full moon nights
Wear Pearl or Moonstone if Moon is well-placed
Avoid stagnant water and damp environments
Engage in nurturing activities — cooking, gardening, caregiving
Travel, especially near water bodies, is favorable
Drink plenty of water and eat cooling foods
moon.challenges: Emotional volatility, mental stress, mother's health concerns, public fickleness
moon.opportunities: Public popularity, emotional maturity, travel, nurturing relationships, creative expression

mars.theme: Courage, action, property, siblings, competition, energy, surgery
mars.career: Excellent for military, police, surgery, sports, engineering, real estate. Competitive fields favor you. Property deals and land acquisition are highlighted. Entrepreneurship thrives.
mars.health: Watch for inflammation, fevers, blood pressure, accidents, cuts, and burns. Pitta aggravation likely. Surgery may be needed for pre-existing conditions. Physical exercise is essential but avoid overexertion.
mars.relationships: Mangal Dosha effects are activated. Passion increases but so does conflict. Sibling relationships come into focus. Marriage needs patience and anger management.
mars.spiritual: Hanuman worship is powerful. Kundalini energy may activate. Good for intense tapas (austerity) and physical yoga practices. Mars period tests courage and willpower.
practical_advice: Channel energy into physical exercise and sports
Pursue property and land acquisition
Be cautious with fire, machinery, and sharp objects
Wear Red Coral if Mars is well-placed
Worship Hanuman on Tuesdays
Avoid unnecessary confrontation and aggression
Focus on sibling relationships and mutual support
Consider surgery for pending health issues
mars.challenges: Accidents, injuries, anger, conflicts, property disputes, sibling fights
mars.opportunities: Property acquisition, competitive victories, physical strength, courageous action

mercury.theme: Intelligence, communication, business, education, skills, adaptability
mercury.career: Best period for business, writing, IT, education, accounting, media, and communication. Intellectual pursuits thrive. Multiple income sources develop. Networking and social skills bring opportunities.
mercury.health: Watch for nervous disorders, skin diseases, speech problems, and allergies. Mental overwork can cause burnout. Nervous system needs care. Good period for alternative and Ayurvedic treatments.
mercury.relationships: Communication becomes the foundation of relationships. Intellectual compatibility matters. Partner appreciates wit and intelligence. Business partnerships thrive.
mercury.spiritual: Good for mantra meditation, especially Vishnu mantras. Study of scriptures and sacred texts. Mercury period favors intellectual spiritual pursuit — astrology, Jyotish study, Vedanta.
practical_advice: Invest in education and skill development
Start or expand a business
Develop writing, speaking, and communication skills
Wear Emerald if Mercury is well-placed
Worship Vishnu on Wednesdays
Network actively and build professional connections
Learn a new language or technical skill
Be cautious with contracts and written agreements
Manage nervous energy through pranayama
Avoid overthinking and analysis paralysis
mercury.challenges: Nervous exhaustion, skin issues, speech problems, business risks, scattered focus
mercury.opportunities: Business success, education, communication mastery, financial growth, intellectual achievement

jupiter.theme: Wisdom, expansion, spirituality, children, teaching, fortune, dharma
jupiter.career: Excellent for teaching, law, consulting, banking, religious work, and philosophical pursuits. Career expansion and promotions likely. Guru-like roles emerge. International opportunities increase.
jupiter.health: Watch for weight gain, diabetes, liver issues, and cholesterol. Kapha aggravation likely. Moderate exercise and dietary discipline needed. Avoid overindulgence in rich foods.
jupiter.relationships: Marriage improves with wisdom and understanding. Children may be born during this period. Family bonds strengthen. Guru-disciple relationships form.
jupiter.spiritual: Most auspicious period for spiritual growth. Guru appears in life. Initiation (diksha) may occur. Temple visits, pilgrimage, and religious study flourish. Worship of Brihaspati (Jupiter).
practical_advice: Pursue higher education and certifications
Expand business and financial portfolio
Focus on family and children's education
Wear Yellow Sapphire if Jupiter is well-placed
Worship Brihaspati on Thursdays
Teach and mentor others
Make charitable donations regularly
Pursue pilgrimage and spiritual travel
Avoid overindulgence in food and luxury
Seek a guru or spiritual teacher
jupiter.challenges: Weight gain, diabetes, liver issues, over-expansion, financial overcommitment
jupiter.opportunities: Wisdom, children, teaching, wealth expansion, spiritual awakening, international travel

venus.theme: Love, beauty, luxury, arts, marriage, pleasure, creativity, wealth
venus.career: Best period for arts, entertainment, fashion, beauty, luxury goods, hospitality, and creative fields. Financial prosperity increases. Career benefits from charm, aesthetics, and diplomacy.
venus.health: Watch for reproductive issues, kidney problems, diabetes, and conditions from overindulgence. Kapha-Pitta aggravation. Moderate lifestyle is key. Beautification and self-care are beneficial.
venus.relationships: Marriage and romance flourish. Love deepens. Spouse becomes more important. New relationships may form. Social life enhances. Wedding may occur during this period.
venus.spiritual: Bhakti (devotion) deepens through beauty and love. Worship of Lakshmi and feminine deities. Art as spiritual practice. Venus period teaches that beauty is a doorway to the divine.
practical_advice: Invest in relationships and marriage
Pursue artistic and creative passions
Acquire luxury items and comfortable lifestyle
Wear Diamond or White Sapphire if Venus is well-placed
Worship Lakshmi on Fridays
Build financial security through beauty and luxury industries
Focus on grooming and appearance
Travel for pleasure and culture
Avoid excessive indulgence in food, drink, and pleasure
Develop diplomacy and social skills
venus.challenges: Over-indulgence, relationship complications, financial extravagance, reproductive issues
venus.opportunities: Marriage, wealth, artistic success, luxury, beauty, romance, creative fulfillment

saturn.theme: Discipline, karma, hard work, service, longevity, structure, justice
saturn.career: Rewards come through persistent hard work only. Government service, engineering, mining, agriculture, and labor-intensive fields. Slow but lasting career growth. Authority earned through merit.
saturn.health: Most challenging period for health. Watch for bones, joints, chronic diseases, depression, and teeth. Vata aggravation. Regular exercise, warm oil massage, and disciplined lifestyle essential.
saturn.relationships: Relationships tested through duty and responsibility. Marriage requires patience. Partner may face health or career difficulties. Loneliness may be felt but character is built.
saturn.spiritual: Deep karmic lessons unfold. Saturn period is the greatest spiritual teacher. Meditation, seva (selfless service), and discipline are the paths. Worship of Hanuman and Shani Dev.
practical_advice: Embrace hard work and discipline
Build structure and routine in daily life
Focus on long-term career and financial goals
Wear Blue Sapphire (with caution) if Saturn is well-placed
Worship Hanuman and Shani on Saturdays
Practice seva (selfless service) regularly
Take care of bones, joints, and teeth
Avoid shortcuts and unethical practices
Be patient — results come slowly but permanently
Oil massage (sesame oil) and warm foods help
Donate to the poor, especially on Saturdays
saturn.challenges: Chronic health, depression, career delays, relationship strain, loneliness, karmic debts
saturn.opportunities: Character building, lasting success, karmic clearance, spiritual depth, longevity, authority

rahu.theme: Ambition, obsession, foreign connections, technology, unconventional paths, illusion
rahu.career: Excellent for technology, foreign trade, media, politics, and unconventional careers. Sudden rises and falls possible. Foreign opportunities are highlighted. Career in large corporations or government.
rahu.health: Watch for mysterious ailments, addictions, poisoning, skin diseases, and mental confusion. Diseases are hard to diagnose. Alternative medicine may help. Avoid intoxicants strictly.
rahu.relationships: Unconventional relationships form. Foreign partner possible. Attraction to unusual people. Marriage may be tested by external influences. Maintain transparency.
rahu.spiritual: Rahu period creates spiritual confusion initially but can lead to deep awakening. Worship of Durga and Saraswati. Mantra meditation is essential. Avoid occult without proper guidance.
practical_advice: Explore foreign and unconventional opportunities
Embrace technology and digital skills
Be cautious with new relationships and partnerships
Wear Hessonite Garnet (Gomed) if Rahu is well-placed
Worship Durga and chant Rahu mantras
Avoid alcohol, drugs, and intoxicants strictly
Be transparent in all dealings
Do not trust blindly — verify everything
Donate to outcasts and marginalized communities
Practice grounding meditation and pranayama
rahu.challenges: Addiction, deception, sudden falls, health mysteries, relationship confusion, illusion
rahu.opportunities: Foreign success, technology mastery, sudden wealth, breaking barriers, unconventional achievement

ketu.theme: Spirituality, detachment, past-life karma, liberation, healing, dissolution
ketu.career: Career may feel directionless or undergo dissolution. Good for spiritual professions, healing, research, and technology (back-end/unseen). Material success is not the primary theme.
ketu.health: Watch for mysterious and hard-to-diagnose ailments, skin conditions, infections, and surgical needs. Alternative and spiritual healing methods work well. Ancestral health patterns may manifest.
ketu.relationships: Detachment from worldly relationships. Spiritual bonds strengthen while material bonds weaken. Past-life connections may appear. Partner may undergo spiritual transformation.
ketu.spiritual: Most powerful period for spiritual liberation (moksha). Past-life karmas resolve. Meditation deepens significantly. Worship of Ganesha. Liberation from material attachments accelerates.
practical_advice: Focus on spiritual practices and meditation
Let go of attachments that no longer serve
Explore past-life healing and regression
Wear Cat's Eye (Lehsunia) if Ketu is well-placed
Worship Ganesha and chant Ketu mantras
Serve animals, especially dogs
Practice mindfulness and present-moment awareness
Avoid clinging to worldly possessions and relationships
Study scriptures and pursue self-inquiry
Donate blankets and donate to spiritual institutions
ketu.challenges: Confusion, directionlessness, health mysteries, relationship dissolution, material losses
ketu.opportunities: Spiritual liberation, past-life healing, deep meditation, intuitive awakening, moksha
